title: The reverse characteristic polynomial is the reverse of the characteristic polynomial
statement:
Let $K$ be a field, $V$ a finite-dimensional $K$-vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace] of dimension $n=\dim_KV$ [def-weil-vector-space-dimension], $F:V\to V$ a $K$-linear endomorphism, $\chi_F(T)=\det(T-F\mid V)$ its characteristic polynomial [def-weil-characteristic-polynomial] and $\det(1-TF\mid V)$ its reverse characteristic polynomial [def-weil-reverse-characteristic-polynomial]. Then

$$
\det(1-TF\mid V)=\operatorname{rev}(\chi_F)(T)=T^n\chi_F(1/T)
$$

[def-weil-reverse-polynomial].
